name: read-then-assert-visible-run-variable
description: a value read during the run reaches the next step through its placeholder, so assertVisible matches the text the variable holds
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: read then assert visible
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- read:
    selector:
      id: code_label
    field: text
    as: code
- assertVisible: "${code}"
